basic_details.job_title: ANH Delhi Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Ambedkar Nagar Hospital Delhi (ANH Delhi), New Delhi, has invited applications for the post of Junior Resident under Advt No. No.F.2(71)/Pt-I/JR-Interview/Admn/ANH/2023/7047-7052. Selection is through a walk-in interview on 21 October 2026.

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.age_details: 30 years for General candidates, 35 years for SC/ST candidate and 33 years for OBC candidates on the date of interview (as on date of interview)

qualification.education_qualification: MBBS Degree recognized by MCI and registered with Delhi Medical Council
qualification.details: Other conditions: | OBC candidates are required to submit their Caste Certificate issued by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi with NON CREAMY LAYER status.

salary_details.pay_scale: Basic pay in level - 10 as per 7th Pay Commission

how_to_apply: Report at the chamber of Head of Office, 4th Floor, Ambedkar Nagar Hospital on the scheduled interview date.
Submit self-attested copies of all documents along with one passport size photograph.
Bring all original certificates and testimonials for verification.
Attend on 21 October 2026, reporting at 10:00 AM.
important_instructions: Registration for interview will be done from 10.00 AM to 11.00 AM on the date of interview. Selected candidates shall be allowed a maximum of 07 days' time for accepting the offer and thereafter 07 days for joining.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ANH Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 21 October 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ANH Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Resident.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ANH Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 21 October 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 30 years for General candidates, 35 years for SC/ST candidate and 33 years for OBC candidates on the date of interview (as on date of interview). Relaxation: SC/ST 35, OBC 33, PWD 10 years relaxable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Basic pay in level - 10 as per 7th Pay Commission.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS Degree recognized by MCI and registered with Delhi Medical Council.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. OBC candidates are required to submit their Caste Certificate issued by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi with NON CREAMY LAYER status.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have completed internship beyond/more than two years from the date of Advertisement. Candidates who have completed one year Junior Residency.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in Interview.
